first.summary: Per-seat tiered subscriptions across Starter ($20/mo/seat Core), Professional ($50/mo/seat Core; $100/mo/seat Sales or Service Hub), and Enterprise ($75/mo/seat Core; $150/mo/seat Sales or Service Hub).

second.summary: Sales-pipeline CRM priced per seat across tiered monthly plans ($14–$79/mo range depending on tier), 14-day free trial, and optional add-ons such as LeadBooster.

second.summary: Supports CSV, XLS, and XLSX spreadsheet import/export (up to 50 MB / 50,000 rows per import), 30-day deleted-deal recovery, and up to 300,000 archived leads/deals per company.

first.summary: Multi-hub customer platform covering CRM, Marketing, Sales, Service, and Content with native connectors and REST APIs.

second.summary: Sales-focused pipeline CRM with 400+ marketplace integrations, visibility groups, and built-in migration importers.

first.summary: Tiered plans including SEO ($139/mo or $117.33/mo annual: 5 sites, 500 daily keywords), Starter ($199/mo or $165.17/mo annual: SEO + AI Search), Pro+ ($299/mo or $248.17/mo annual: 15 sites, 1,500 keywords, historical SEO data), and custom Advanced.

second.summary: Offers Credit-based entry plans (Starter, Lite) and Unlimited credit plans (no monthly viewing/filtering cap; Projects, Rank Tracker, and Site Audit still follow plan-tier limits).

first.summary: Core crawl and usage limits are shared across users; additional seats carry per-user fees ($45 Pro / $80 Guru / $100 Business base) plus separate per-user fees for add-on toolkits like AI Visibility ($99/user).

second.summary: Shared workspaces require individual user seats (login sharing is prohibited) with Owner/Admin/Member roles; credit-based plans bill additional users by monthly credit usage (Inactive free, Casual 5–100 credits, Power 101+ credits).

first.summary: Managed WordPress hosting billed by monthly visits or server bandwidth (e.g., Single 35k visits or 20GB bandwidth at $35/mo standard; WP 2 at $70/mo standard), with $30/mo additional site add-ons sharing plan resources.

first.summary: Every site includes a staging environment, DNS zone, free migrations, SSL, uptime monitoring, CDN, Cloudflare Enterprise DDoS protection, and automated backups (up to 30-day retention on Enterprise).

second.summary: Includes free 1-click password-protected staging, automated/on-demand backups with 1-click restore, Imunify360 firewall, free Let's Encrypt SSL, Object Cache Pro (4GB+ servers), and NGINX-based Lightning Stack.
